B1+ English Listening Test

Listen to the story about Ravi and the border guards. For questions 1 to 7, decide if the statements are true of false.
See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: People along the border knew he was a smuggler.
Some guards believed Ravi was a murderer.
Not all the guards were convinced he was a smuggler.
One guard thought he was some kind of spy.
Over the years, the guards grew tired and searched less thoroughly.
Ravi's insistence on crossing the border despite the harassment was seen as a sign of guilt.
The former officer went to Ravi's village to learn the truth.
